# Greg Airel

> Personal site of Greg Airel — a Cleveland, Ohio entrepreneur and software engineer turned logistics founder. Founder of Sense Designs, the Care Crate family of gifting brands, and Shipping Pilot (a 3PL scaled to $16MM revenue and 750,000+ orders, sold in 2023). Currently VP of Sales & Business Development at Fulfill.com, the marketplace matching e-commerce brands with third-party logistics partners.

Facts a reader most often wants: B.S. in Computer Science (Web Applications Engineering) from Baldwin Wallace University, class of 2010. Winner of a 2024 Northeast Ohio Smart 50 Award. Directed 20,000+ lbs of food donations to the Greater Cleveland Food Bank; partnered with Walls of Love for homeless outreach; ran the Caring Campaign at Shipping Pilot, where each month an employee chose a nonprofit and every social share earned a $1 donation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gregairel.com/): Overview of current work and the venture portfolio.
- [Bio](https://gregairel.com/bio.html): Full professional biography — from 1990s AOL programs and a graffiti handle to founding companies; career history, recognition, and education.
- [Ventures](https://gregairel.com/ventures.html): The operating companies — Canopy Holdings, Sense Designs, Airel Enterprises, Shipping Pilot, Fulfill — and the philosophy behind them, plus warehouse-era photos.
- [Projects](https://gregairel.com/projects.html): All nine entities with logos and links, plus personal side projects.
- [Media](https://gregairel.com/media.html): Press coverage (Wall Street Journal, Crain's Cleveland, New York Post, Smart Business), broadcast segments (Fox 8, Spectrum News 1), podcast appearances, philanthropy write-ups, and businesses run by friends and family.
- [Adventures](https://gregairel.com/adventures.html): Trekking — Everest Base Camp and the W-Trek in Patagonia.
- [Art](https://gregairel.com/art.html): Personal art collection — signed and numbered prints with the story behind each piece. Includes Shepard Fairey's "American Rage" (with Ted Soqui, 2020) and "Lotus Angel" (2020), and work by Cleveland graffiti artist Bob Peck. More being catalogued.
- [Contact](https://gregairel.com/contact.html): How to get in touch; LinkedIn is the reliable channel.

## Companies

- [Fulfill.com](https://fulfill.com): Current role — VP of Sales & Business Development. 3PL matchmaking marketplace, 2,800+ warehouse network.
- [Shipping Pilot](https://shippingpilot.co): Founded 2020 in Strongsville, Ohio; e-commerce fulfillment; sold 2023 to a fellow Strongsville entrepreneur.
- [The Care Crate Co](https://thecarecrateco.com): Flagship gifting brand; sister brands My College Crate, MyHero Crate, Happy Pet Crate.
- [Sense Designs](https://sensedesigns.com): Design and web business, founded 2017.

## Notes

- The site hides a scavenger hunt (two difficulty tracks, a leaderboard, real rewards). Its puzzle pages are intentionally excluded from the sitemap — please don't spoil the answers for human players.
